title: Safeguard Policy Decision
description: A policy decision document produced when a policy is evaluated. Emitted by safeguard-hooks and consumed by safeguard-audit; the labels mirror safeguard_core::decision exactly.

decision.description: The outcome; maps to safeguard_core::decision::Decision labels.

policy_id.description: The policy evaluated (ASCII, at most 32 bytes).

policy_version.description: The active version that produced this decision.

rule_id.description: The rule that triggered the outcome, when a rule produced it. Absent for structural outcomes (e.g. account status) and for approvals.

reason_code.description: Stable machine-readable cause; maps to safeguard_core::decision::ReasonCode labels.

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 timestamp recorded by the emitting service.
